evidence: open('app.log', 'a', encoding='utf-8')
an existing file with the same name will be erased
preserves the existing content and appends to the end.

evidence: the file is properly closed after the suite finishes, even if an exception is raised.
might result in the arguments of `f.write()` not being completely written to the disk

points.answer_text: readline返回空串表示文件结束；仅含'\n'表示空白行。
evidence: if `f.readline()` returns an empty string, the end of the file has been reached
a blank line is represented by `'\n'`, a string containing only a single newline.

evidence: for line in f: print(line, end='')
